caption: The drawing shows three distinct hand tools, arranged vertically in a single column, centered on a plain, beige background. Each tool has an elongated, oval-shaped, brown wooden handle with visible wood grain details. The top tool has a metallic shaft that is short, thin, curved, and tapers to a point, colored in a dull brass or gold tone. The middle tool features a similarly shaped wooden handle, but its metallic shaft is straight for most of its length, ending suddenly in a sharp, hook-like feature, colored in a grayish-silver. The bottom tool, with the same wooden handle style, has a longer metallic shaft that bends at an angle and then tapers to a point, also colored grayish-silver. The tools are spaced evenly apart and their shafts are all oriented in the same direction, with the handles toward the left side of the image and the points facing to the right.
title: Rug Hooks
